messages:
maria: Heads up — docs PR 7294 is blocked by runtime confirm on streaming cancellation semantics. @alex can you confirm?
ben: what's unclear? the PR adds an SDK snippet for aborting streaming requests and mentions that incomplete chunks are dropped — need exact behavior.
alex: I think runtime currently stops sending further chunks once the connection closes but keeps the in-flight token accounting; depending on transport it may send partial buffer. Need to verify.
maria: CI/docs preview also failing linkcheck on the new migration guide link. docs-ci-bot: linkcheck failed: /docs/migration/streaming => 404.
cj: I can fix the link but we need an authoritative statement for the SDK snippet: should we recommend AbortController for Node and requests.Session for Python?
ben: propose adding two minimal examples and an explicit note: 'on cancel, server stops emitting further tokens; partial token may be included in last chunk; partial outputs are not cached' — is that accurate @alex?
alex: Not fully. Clarify: runtime flushes any buffered tokens immediately on disconnect; no extra generation is performed after abort. KV cache will keep any persisted cache from completed steps, but partial generation isn't cached. So wording: 'runtime flushes buffer and stops generation; partial tokens may be returned in the last chunk; partial outputs are not cached.'
maria: perfect. I'll update the PR with the exact phrasing and two snippets. Draft snippets: 
```js
// Node example
const ac = new AbortController();
const resp = await client.chat.stream({model:'redwood-1', messages}, {signal: ac.signal});
// cancel after 200ms
setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),200);
``` 
```py
# Python example
resp = client.chat.stream(model='redwood-1', messages=messages)
# client exposes .close() in latest sdk to cancel
resp.close()
```
ben: add a note about billing: cancelling still bills tokens for what was produced.
alex: correct. runtime bills tokens generated up to abort.
maria: ok will add billing sentence and fix link. docs-ci-bot: preview build succeeded for updated TOC, linkcheck still failing — the link needs a redirect.
cj: I'll add a redirect in the docs router.
maria: thanks, setting reviewers to @ben and @alex; if we get a quick ack I'll merge after green CI. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: merge hold removed by maria.
ben: acked, LGTM once CI passes.
alex: ack.
maria: merging once link redirect and final lint pass done, thanks all.
